items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: I had just known that he had played with Woody Herman, that’s John Bonnie, and was a great player in that style, and the Lester Youngish, a little more modern style.

ctx.x: Well just by seeing where musicians played and being on the scene and seeing it was a rough life. Unbeknownst to me though, going back on it, a lot of the Philly cats, who I saw — and I don’t remember the name of the place — there were Sunday afternoon jam sessions in South Philly with some of these names you might know, maybe you wouldn’t, names like Vince Montana; Buddy Savitt, tenor player; Vince was a vibist. John Bonnie, alto saxophone, local cats. And I would always wonder myself, gee, they’re playing here,…
Let me go back because you froze up for a minute when you said who was the most listened to tenor player.
